trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.nba_championships = '0' AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2 AND p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] WITH p.position AS position, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS max_mvp RETURN position AS col1, max_mvp AS col2

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE CAST(COALESCE(p.nba_championships, p.championships) AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND CAST(COALESCE(p.nba_championships, p.championships) AS INT64) <> 2 AND p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] WITH p.position AS position, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS max_mvp RETURN position AS col1, max_mvp AS col2

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE CAST(COALESCE(p.nba_championships, p.championships) AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 WITH CASE WHEN p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Center', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Forward'] OR p.position CONTAINS 'Forward' OR p.position CONTAINS 'Center' THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN p.position IN ['Backcourt', 'Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard'] OR p.position CONTAINS 'Guard' THEN 'Backcourt' ELSE NULL END AS position, CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp WHERE position IS NOT NULL RETURN position AS col1, MAX(mvp) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE (p.nba_championships = '0' OR p.championships = '0') AND p.draft_year IS NOT NULL AND p.draft_year > '2014' WITH CASE WHEN p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Forward', 'F', 'PF', 'SF', 'Center', 'C'] OR p.position CONTAINS 'Forward' OR p.position CONTAINS 'Center' THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN p.position IN ['Backcourt', 'Guard', 'G', 'PG', 'SG'] OR p.position CONTAINS 'Guard' THEN 'Backcourt' END AS position, CAST(COALESCE(p.mvp_awards, '0') AS INT64) AS mvp WHERE position IS NOT NULL RETURN position AS col1, MAX(mvp) AS col2
